howto: Press Drop in and race three rivals 2 km down the mountain to the finish arch.
Carve to steer, tuck for speed, brake to scrub it off.
Hold jump to crouch and release to ollie; the kickers throw you high.
In the air, spin, flip and grab, then land with the board pointing down the hill or you crash.
Tricks score points and fill the boost meter. Burn boost to pass the rivals.
tips: Let go of the spin just before you land: the board settles onto the fall line by itself.
Hold a grab for more than 0.7 s to tweak it for extra points.
Land your next trick within 3.5 s to raise the combo, up to x5. A crash resets it.
Rail points only count once you land cleanly after popping off the rail.
The first kicker, at 90 m, is the gentle one: try your first grab there.
Trees and rocks crash you and cost about two seconds, so pick lines through the open snow.

controls.keyboard: A / D or ← / → carve (spin in the air), W / ↑ tuck (front flip in the air), S / ↓ brake (back flip in the air), Space hold and release to ollie, J K L grabs, Shift boost, Esc or P pause.
controls.touch: Left thumb pad steers, tucks and brakes (spins and flips in the air). Hold JUMP and let go to ollie, hold GRAB in the air, tap BOOST to burn the meter.
controls.gamepad: Left stick steers, tucks and brakes; A ollies; X, Y and B grab (Indy, Melon, Method); RB or RT boosts.

difficulty: Adaptive: the three rivals ease off when they get far ahead of you and boost when you pull away, so every race stays close. Kickers grow from a gentle 1.3 m lip at 90 m to 3.6 m near the bottom.

cheats.effect: Unlimited boost: the meter never drains
Moon gravity: one sixth g in the air, huge hang time
Ride straight through trees and rocks

tricks.name: FS 180 / 360 / 540 / 720+
tricks.input: Hold D or → in the air (touch: thumb pad right)

tricks.name: BS 180 / 360 / 540 / 720+
tricks.input: Hold A or ← in the air (touch: thumb pad left)

tricks.name: Frontflip (Double, Triple)
tricks.input: Hold W or ↑ in the air (touch: thumb pad up)

tricks.name: Backflip (Double, Triple)
tricks.input: Hold S or ↓ in the air (touch: thumb pad down)

tricks.name: Indy grab
tricks.input: Hold J in the air (gamepad X)

tricks.name: Melon grab
tricks.input: Hold K in the air (gamepad Y)

tricks.name: Method grab
tricks.input: Hold L in the air (gamepad B); touch GRAB cycles Melon, Method, Indy

tricks.name: Tweaked grab / Indy to Melon
tricks.input: Hold a grab past 0.7 s, or switch grab keys mid-air

tricks.name: Boardslide
tricks.input: Ride onto a rail with speed; tap Space (JUMP) to pop off early

tricks.name: 50-50 to Boardslide
tricks.input: Stay on a rail for more than 1.4 s

tricks.name: Big Air
tricks.input: Hang 1.25 s or more with no other trick

tricks.name: Combo x2 to x5
tricks.input: Land the next trick within 3.5 s; a crash resets it

settings.quality: Title > Quality: Low, Medium or High (Low turns off shadows and thins the forest; High raises resolution, trees and particles). The game reloads to apply it and remembers the choice.
settings.sound: Title > sound button; Controls (title and pause) has Music and Effects sliders, saved. The same sliders are in the arcade's How to play panel.

features.trick-system: Spins (FS/BS 180 to 1440), single to triple front and back flips, Indy, Melon and Method grabs with tweaks and grab-to-grab, Boardslide and 50-50 rails, Big Air, all scored by the board physics
features.trick-list: Controls (title and pause) lists the 12 moves with their inputs; so does Tricks in the arcade menu
features.combo: Each trick landed within 3.5 s of the last raises the multiplier up to x5 (COMBO xN under the trick name); a crash resets it
features.land-bail-feedback: Landings throw snow, thump, shake the camera and tag Stomped or Sketchy; bails name the reason (Caught an edge, Over-rotated, Flat landing, Hit a tree or rock) with a crash sound
features.trick-tutorial: First race: five coach cards (carve, tuck, ollie, first trick, boost) that advance when you do each move, with a Skip button; the arcade's How to play > Replay tutorial runs it again
features.results: Results card: medal and place, time, trick score, top speed, air time, best trick, an S to D rank and the finish order; Race again replays
features.saving: Personal best time and points are kept in localStorage and shown on the title; a run with codes on never writes them
features.pause: In a race: the game's own pause button, Esc, P, leaving the window or the arcade's Pause open its panel, now with a tip. On the title and results the arcade's pause button (top right) opens the arcade menu.
features.audio: Race music under the game's own wind, carve and trick sounds, and a crowd cheer at the finish arch
